title: RIFT BAO Sound Horizon from First Principles
description: Derive r_d from RIFT perturbation theory. Integrate RIFT FLRW+scalar system through radiation era and recombination, computing the effective sound horizon from the photon-baryon plasma with RIFT-modified H(z). Compare to LCDM r_d.

scalar_field.comment_m0: Compton wavelength ~100 Mpc; from SIM87 best-fit regime

physics.rd_integral: rd = integral from z_drag to inf of cs(z) / (H(z)*(1+z)) dz
